meta.name: SP-404MK2 modulation suggestions
meta.note: Opinions, not MIDI facts. The map JSON stays the source of truth for CCs and ranges; this file only says which parameters are worth moving and how. Every param name here is validated against effects_parameters at build time.
meta.rate_units: Hz for free-running moves. Suggestions that are rhythmic also carry a 'sync' note division: the app uses it when the SP is sending clock (MIDI Sync Out = ON), locking phase to the unit's own downbeat, and falls back to the typed tempo otherwise.
meta.depth_units: percent of the parameter's full CC range, applied either side of the knob's current value when bipolar
meta.position_units: Percent of the parameter range where the swing is centred. 50 is the middle. Anything else is a judgement that one end of that parameter is musically worse than the other — runaway feedback, screaming resonance, a fully shut filter.

shapes.label: Tri
shapes.best_for: continuous ranges — linear up and down, no dwell at the extremes

shapes.label: Sqr
shapes.best_for: switches and rhythmic gates — the only shape that crosses a threshold cleanly

shapes.label: S&H
shapes.best_for: lists and discrete types — holds a random value per step
